sourceText:
Easy and Quick Quiche
By: Eat In Calgary
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 8:14am

Ingredients




3 eggs
2 tablespoons margarine
2 tablespoons tomato sauce
milk

white flour

1 red pepper
2 green onions
grated cheese

salt

pepper

paprika

crust/ pie shell/ frozen pastry

Preparation

1 Mix eggs with margarine, some milk and white flour. 2 Add tomato sauce, chopped red pepper and green onions. 3 Add salt, pepper and paprika. 4 Add grated cheese - or if using, crust, sprinkle it on the shell then pour the eggs mixture. 5 Bake in shell for 45 min (375F).

About


You can add any favorite toppings: mushrooms, ham, tomatoes, olives, bacon, salami, sausages, spinach, etc.
